error.message: 🔒 CWE-327 OWASP:A04-Cryptographic CVSS:7.5 | Use of weak hash algorithm: MD5. MD5 is cryptographically broken and unsuitable for security purposes. | CRITICAL [PCI-DSS,HIPAA,ISO27001,NIST-CSF] Fix: Replace with sha256: crypto.createHash("sha256").update(data). If this hash is an identifier rather than a security control — an EVALSHA key, an ETag, a cache key — store it under one of the nonCryptographicNames instead. | https://owasp.org/www-community/vulnerabilities/Weak_Cryptography

🔒 CWE-327 OWASP:A04-Cryptographic CVSS:7.5 | ECB mode encrypts identical plaintext blocks to identical ciphertext, leaking data patterns. Famous example: the "ECB penguin". | HIGH [PCI-DSS,HIPAA,ISO27001,NIST-CSF] Fix: Use GCM mode for authenticated encryption: crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", key, iv) | https://blog.cloudflare.com/why-are-some-images-more-secure-than-others/

🔒 CWE-295 OWASP:A02-Security CVSS:7.4 | rejectUnauthorized: false disables TLS certificate validation, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks. Any certificate will be accepted, including self-signed and expired ones. | CRITICAL Fix: Remove rejectUnauthorized: false or set it to true | https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Transport_Layer_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html
